title: Bootstrap the web/API workspace and repeatable CI
owner: Root manifests/lockfiles, apps/web scaffold, services/api scaffold, .github/workflows, dev compose and root scripts
implementation: Create Yarn Next.js/TypeScript and Rust Axum workspaces, pin stable toolchains, PostgreSQL and local SMTP capture in development. Establish documented lint/typecheck/test/generation/e2e commands, environment examples without secrets, /health/live and /health/ready (readiness checks DB), and clean-clone CI. Add repository AGENTS.md explaining ownership and verification. No domain routes.
acceptance: Given a clean clone and documented prerequisites, when setup runs, then web/API/DB/mail capture start and health checks work.
Given missing required configuration or unavailable DB, readiness fails clearly without leaking secrets; lint/build/tests run in CI.
verify: Build both applications; run formatting/lint/typecheck and a health smoke check against real PostgreSQL. Record setup commands from clean checkout.
nonGoals: Domain functionality, finished design, production deployment.

title: Create the canonical PostgreSQL schema and migration registry
implementation: Implement C02 entities, FKs, unique constraints, revision types, indexes for listed cursor/filter paths, job leases and cascade/tombstone boundaries. This issue is the sole initial migration owner. Record allocation and forward-only production policy. Provide test DB factory and fixtures as explicit development/test data only; never seed Ana into real accounts.
acceptance: Given empty PostgreSQL, all ordered migrations apply and schema matches C02.
Given duplicate provider identity, duplicate follow pair, self-follow or invalid status, DB constraints reject it.
Given user deletion, private state can be erased without unintentionally cascading another user’s comments/history.
verify: Run migrations against fresh PostgreSQL; constraint and lifecycle tests; document schema coverage table.
nonGoals: HTTP handlers and business workflows; later migration changes need coordinated allocation.

title: Encode and validate the canonical OpenAPI and generated client
owner: contracts/openapi.yaml, packages/api-client/**, generator config and contract CI only
implementation: Transcribe every C03–C08 endpoint into OpenAPI including DTOs, required/omitted spoiler fields, request/response/error examples, status codes, cookies/CSRF, pagination and idempotency headers. Generate typed TypeScript client using a pinned generator. Add lint and regenerate/diff check. Export operation-to-issue mapping; no endpoint placeholders or permissive any schemas.
acceptance: Given the contract, generation produces a type-safe client covering every endpoint.
Given locked Episode DTO, validation rejects protected details and accepts the exact redacted example.
Given a changed schema without regenerated client, CI fails.
verify: Validate OpenAPI, compile generated client, run schema example tests for success/redacted/errors and generation drift.
nonGoals: Rust implementations and frontend feature integration.

title: Build design tokens, navigation shell and basic primitives
implementation: Implement token imports, bundled typography, responsive header/nav, Buttons/Fields/Badges/Tabs/Progress/Poster/Avatar/Skeleton/Empty/Error primitives. Three alpha tabs, beta Friends and notification access. Keep API data out of primitives; no prototype controls. Export stable component props and component gallery.
acceptance: Given 320/390/860/1440 viewport, navigation switches at860 without overflow and all targets>=44px.
Given missing art, fallback preserves2:3 or16:9 without layout shift; reduced motion and keyboard focus work.
verify: Component tests for keyboard/disabled labels; axe gallery; browser screenshots and contrast check.
nonGoals: Overlays, feature routes and authenticated data.

title: Implement accessible sheets, dialogs, menus and feedback
design: D01; prototype catch-up dialog and add sheet
implementation: Implement controlled Dialog/Sheet/Menu/Toast primitives with focus trap/restore, Escape/cancel, live-region messages, mobile bottom/desktop centered layout. Success6s, errors persist, optional Undo/Retry/Dismiss callbacks. Busy controls prevent duplicate action. Do not place API calls or progress algorithms in primitives.
acceptance: Given keyboard-only opening, focus stays in modal and returns to trigger on cancel.
Given failed operation, error persists with Retry/Dismiss; success expires after6s; reduced motion disables transitions.
verify: Focus/keyboard/timeout component tests and axe; browser320/390/1440 overlay screenshots.
nonGoals: Feature dialogs, backend mutation semantics.

title: Implement cookie sessions, CSRF and API error middleware
implementation: Implement session hashing/store/expiry/rotation, anonymous CSRF bootstrap, GET/session, logout, identity extraction, verified-user/operator guards, same-origin/CSRF checks, no-store, safe request IDs, body/rate limits. Export router/middleware builders for integration; do not edit shared main router yet. Logout removes grants.
acceptance: Given expired/revoked session, protected call returns401 without user data.
Given missing/wrong CSRF or off-origin mutation, return403 and no write.
Given logout, old session and reveal grants cannot be reused.
verify: PostgreSQL/API tests for cookies, expiry clock, CSRF, rate-limit429, no-store and logout revocation.
nonGoals: Password/Google flows and final shared router assembly.

title: Implement registration, verification and SMTP outbox delivery
implementation: Implement register/verify/resend, Argon2id hashing off executor, generic responses, single-use hashed tokens,24h expiry,60s cooldown. SMTP delivery through durable outbox with retry/lease/dedupe; HTML and plain text messages contain correct configured origin links. Verification rotates session; no library access before verification.
acceptance: Given new email, registration queues one usable verification link and stores no plaintext password/token.
Given used/expired token, verification fails410 with recovery; resend invalidates old token.
Given existing account or SMTP outage, responses remain enumeration-safe and outbox retry does not create duplicate accounts.
verify: Real DB and local SMTP integration; token replay/expiry, duplicate signup, retry tests.
nonGoals: Password reset, Google and UI.

title: Implement password login, recovery and fresh reauthentication
implementation: Implement login, password-reset-request/reset and reauth; generic invalid credentials; correct unverified login routes to verification without application access. Reset30m single-use, revokes all sessions/grants; allow verified mailbox owner to establish password for SSO account. Fresh reauth window5m. Reuse mail/session services.
acceptance: Given correct verified credentials, login returns rotated session.
Given reset completes, prior sessions and token replay fail and new password works.
Given reset for unknown email, response does not disclose existence.
verify: DB/API tests including reset race, expiry, password boundaries, rate limits and last reset invalidation.
nonGoals: Google, account deletion and frontend forms.

title: Implement Google sign-in and explicit identity linking
implementation: Implement OIDC authorization-code flow with PKCE/state/nonce validation using maintained library, fixed Google discovery, verified email, safe callback/returnTo,10m flow expiry and single use. Use issuer+subject identity. Support signin/link/reauth intents, identity listing/unlink. Same email never auto-links. No long-lived Google tokens; prevent unlinking last method.
acceptance: Given valid new Google identity, create one private account/session; repeated subject signs into same account.
Given matching email with unknown subject, require explicit authenticated linking.
Given replay/wrong nonce/audience/state or last-method unlink, fail without account mutation.
verify: Mock OIDC/JWKS protocol tests for valid, canceled, expired, wrong claims, linking races; manual real Google smoke deferred to release with credentials.
nonGoals: Other SSO providers, Google data access, deployment credentials provisioning.

title: Build account, recovery and Google sign-in screens
implementation: Use generated client for email/password/verify/resend/reset/session/Google redirect and linkage/reauth UI. Add profile name/handle onboarding, busy/field/form errors, expiry recovery and accessible Google button. Never simulate verification or inject sample library on login. Store no credentials/session token in localStorage. Router wiring is verified at R24.
acceptance: Given new email user, screens lead through real verification to discover.
Given canceled Google flow or expired reset, user gets recoverable error and alternate method.
Given401 during private navigation, return to signin without retaining another user’s cached data.
verify: Component tests for all auth states with typed fixtures; browser keyboard/mobile/desktop checks; R24 must replace any fixture harness with live API.
nonGoals: Provider implementation, settings privacy and full application router wiring.

title: Implement TMDB TV search and atomic catalog import
implementation: Search TV only with q/page validation and bounded timeout/cache. Import selected show and seasons/episodes atomically, unique stable provider IDs, map nulls/status/date-only safely. Failed partial import never usable. Duplicate imports converge. Configure image URLs and provider attribution data, no browser credentials. Use reusable provider trait and recorded test fixtures.
acceptance: Given same-title results, API includes year/genre/poster metadata to distinguish.
Given concurrent import of same TMDB show, return same app ID without duplicates.
Given429/timeout/null date/missing poster, return defined failure or safe null without losing stored progress.
verify: Provider fixture contract tests, DB import rollback/uniqueness tests; verify no raw payload/secret in response.
nonGoals: Scheduled refresh, progress logic and catalog viewer DTOs.

title: Refresh metadata without losing watch history
implementation: Implement24h refresh worker with DB job lease,429 Retry-After/backoff,48h stale flag, last-good retention. Match episodes by TMDB identity through renumbering; atomic collision handling and catalog revision increment; archive removed episodes without deleting progress. Make clock injectable. Update discovered episodes and completion inputs.
acceptance: Given provider outage, saved metadata/history remain usable and stale is disclosed.
Given new released episode, next read moves caught-up show to in-progress.
Given episode renumbering/removal, history retains identity and preview revision becomes stale.
verify: DB/clock tests for refresh lease recovery,429,collision,renumber/archive,stale and incomplete catalog.
nonGoals: UI, provider licensing procurement and release clock algorithm.

title: Implement pure per-episode progress and release rules
implementation: Implement season/episode ordered regular progress, next released unwatched, out-of-order, count/percent, caught-up/completed/not-yet/release-unknown. Specials excluded from aggregates. Future/undated individual marks count but do not change release status. UTC-midnight fallback, incomplete catalog blocks Completed, ended known all-marked takes priority. No I/O.
acceptance: Given E1/E3 marked, E2 is next and outOfOrder=true.
Given undated episode, it cannot become next and blocks Completed even when marked.
Given empty/future-only/ongoing/ended catalog, derived states follow C05 exactly.
verify: Table/property tests with fixed clock, timezone boundaries, empty totals, specials and future marked cases.
nonGoals: Persistence, API handlers and UI.

title: Implement reusable privacy and spoiler projection policies
implementation: Implement pure access decisions with separate privacy gate and spoiler gate. Details use individual watched; discussion uses all regular through target or scoped grant; special discussion explicit grant only. Define redacted DTO constructors that cannot accidentally serialize details. Mutual host policy and bilateral block filtering; public library requires signed-in viewer.
acceptance: Given E3 watched/E2 gap, detail allowed and discussion locked.
Given discussion grant for A, B at same episode remains locked.
Given privacy revocation, grant cannot authorize access; protected projection omits keys entirely.
verify: Exhaustive truth table tests for role/follow/block/progress/grant/session/special combinations and JSON key absence.
nonGoals: HTTP grant persistence, following workflows and comments.

title: Implement personal library and profile persistence APIs
implementation: Implement library listing/filter counts/search and save/remove/status writes with expected revision/idempotency and action recording. Removal retains history; manual Completed rejected. Profile display-name/initial handle validation and uniqueness, no role changes. Home uses saved watching only, but libraryEmpty reflects all saved. Export module routers.
acceptance: Given removed then readded show, progress/manual status restored.
Given invalid manual Completed or stale revision, no mutation.
Given handle collision or attempted role change, reject safely; private default remains.
verify: DB/API tests for owner isolation,revision/idempotency,filter counts,history retention and profile uniqueness.
nonGoals: Per-episode writes, undo endpoint implementation, frontend and shared router assembly.

title: Persist individual watched changes and conflict-safe Undo
implementation: Implement individual true/false marks for released/future/undated/special episodes, auto-save/status upgrade rules, revision/idempotency, mutation actions and per-field provenance. Implement10m action Undo with skipped conflicts and repeat outcome. Use same action bookkeeping interface as library writes; false rows retain revisions. History erase uses aggregate revision, explicit API and same Undo engine.
acceptance: Given future episode, mark persists and metadata stays future.
Given A:true B:false C:true, Undo A skips C despite matching value.
Given repeated request key or Undo, no duplicate action/event; other user cannot undo.
verify: PostgreSQL transaction/concurrency tests, lost-response idempotency, selective rollback,history erase and owner isolation.
nonGoals: Bulk catch-up previews, social event projection and UI.

title: Implement explicit catch-up preview and atomic commit
implementation: Preview exact eligible regular released unmarked IDs through chosen endpoint and list all exclusions. Persist5m preview bound to user/catalog/progress/library revisions. Commit exact set transactionally with idempotency, auto-save/status rules and Undo provenance. No special endpoint and no silent expansion on metadata changes. Zero count returns no-op.
acceptance: Given released/marked/future/undated/special mix, preview count/list match contract and excludes future even if endpoint future.
Given a progress or metadata change before confirm,409 and zero writes.
Given valid commit then Undo, previously marked episodes remain watched.
verify: DB tests for stale/expired/cross-user preview,transaction race,no-op,idempotency and undo.
nonGoals: Implicit catch-up, UI and alternate episode orders.

Given all shows on-hold, Home shows choose-a-show state rather than false empty-library message.

Given ambiguous title, user selects correct year and saves correct provider result.
Given import/search/save failure, retain query and offer retry without duplicate library entry.

Given canceled incomplete show, display caught-up not completed.
Given failed status/remove, current server state can be recovered without overwriting later edits.

Stale preview requires refresh and reconfirm.

Given future episode, mark enabled but future label remains.

Browser title/metadata/prefetch use code not protected title. Reserve discussion slot hidden in alpha.

Given reveal then Hide again or logout, protected cache removed and screen redacted.

Given new release after caught-up, refetch shows next unwatched.
Given no friends or library, primary solo search/save journey remains visible.

Reuse privacy policy on every read/write. Account handle required for social writes. Emit deduplicated follow-request outbox item. All module routes beta-gated; no main router edits.

Given public target, follow approves immediately; anonymous access still denied.
Given decline/remove/unfollow, access changes immediately and no unwanted notification sent.

implementation: Implement privacy switch, blocks listing/add/remove. Block atomically removes edges both ways, pending notifications and affected grants. Public→private immediately hides library/activity from nonfollowers; public switch does not auto-approve pending requests. Unblock restores no relationships. Reuse policy gate in viewer projections.

Given public→private, unapproved viewer loses library visibility immediately.
Given unblock, both follow directions stay absent.

implementation: Project completed library/mark actions into deduplicated activity; no-op/replay duplicates absent, Undo removes corresponding events, bulk catch-up at most endpoint event if changed. Filter current follows/privacy/blocks at read. Recommend visible unsaved shows by followed-person count with deterministic ordering; empty no-friends result. Never store/return episode text in activity.

Given later block/privacy revocation, old event no longer visible.
Given mark retry/Undo, no duplicates and reversed event removed; only episode code exposed.

nonGoals: AI/trending recommendations and UI.

Export feed/recommendation components for Home/Discover integration in R38. Include empty/error/loading/pending and participants visibility copy. Never simulate approval timer.

Given blocked/private viewer, no hidden library counts or activity render.
Given empty friends, search available and personal Home remains useful.

About TMDB attribution. Use API responses not local-only toggles; pending/errors accessible. Data controls linked only when beta enabled.

Given public switch, warning precedes write; failed save retains authoritative visibility.

Special explicit reveal, undated gap locking, per-thread grants, participant block filtering, tombstones. Integrate existing reveal service permission decisions, no main router edits.

Given same-episode threads A/B, grant A does not reveal B.
Given unrelated participant blocked, comments/identity/count contribution absent but host access preserved.

Report approved reasons, one active report per viewer/comment, hide for reporter immediately. Escape rendered text via DTO/client; no edits/attachments/link previews.

Given report, reporter no longer receives body; unrelated readers still see until moderation.

nonGoals: Operator resolution and reactions.
